title: Graviclaw
definition: A dark-element Xalian of Grimedes, the Graviclaw is a chitin-armored, crab-bodied ambush predator that lurks beneath the planet's wetlands, thickening gravity into a snaring well to draw prey into its crushing claws. It can also anchor itself against its will being moved, standing as an immovable wall of shell when confronted by larger foes.
